Here is my application: http://spark.rstudio.com/withr/authentication/. The username is: withr, and password is: 123456.
For more information, please take a look of: http://withr.me/blog/2014/01/03/authentication-of-shiny-server-application-using-a-simple-method/

Best Regards!

Huidong

parts:
Btw, your algortihm depends on the passwords stored being unique. This normally should be the case, but the following is less error-prone (I think):

        Username <- isolate(input$Username)
        Password <- isolate(input$Password)
        Id.username <- which(PASSWORD$Brukernavn == Username)
        savedPassword = PASSWORD$Passord[Id.username]
        if (length(Id.username) > 0 & length(savedPassword) > 0) {
          if (Password == savedPassword) {
            USER$Role <- PASSWORD$Role[Id.username]
            USER$Logged <- TRUE

}
